items.title: Incorrect Authorization Vulnerability leading to Privilege Escalation (Account Takeover)
items.summary: A critical incorrect authorization vulnerability in Adobe Commerce and Magento Open Source could allow an unauthenticated attacker to switch a customer session to another customer account, leading to account takeover and access to private data.

items.title: Stored Cross-Site Scripting (XSS) Vulnerability leading to Arbitrary Code Execution
items.summary: A stored cross-site scripting vulnerability in Adobe Commerce and Magento Open Source could result in arbitrary code execution. Exploitation requires authentication but not administrator privileges.

items.title: Stored Cross-Site Scripting (XSS) Vulnerability leading to Arbitrary Code Execution
items.summary: A stored cross-site scripting vulnerability in Adobe Commerce and Magento Open Source could result in arbitrary code execution. Exploitation requires authentication and administrator privileges.

items.title: Incorrect Authorization Vulnerability leading to Security Feature Bypass
items.summary: An incorrect authorization vulnerability affecting Adobe Commerce B2B could enable a security-feature bypass. Exploitation requires authentication but not administrator privileges.

items.title: Incorrect Authorization Vulnerability leading to Security Feature Bypass
items.summary: An incorrect authorization vulnerability in Adobe Commerce and Magento Open Source could enable a security-feature bypass. It requires neither authentication nor administrator privileges.

items.title: Security update available for Adobe Commerce and Magento Open Source
items.summary: This security update resolves critical and important vulnerabilities, including arbitrary code execution, security feature bypass, and privilege escalation. Adobe released isolated patches for these issues.

items.title: Security update available for Adobe Commerce and Magento Open Source
items.summary: Adobe released a security update for Adobe Commerce and Magento Open Source addressing critical and important vulnerabilities that could lead to security feature bypass, privilege escalation, arbitrary file system read, and application denial-of-service.

items.title: Security update available for Adobe Commerce and Magento Open Source
items.summary: This Adobe security update for Commerce and Magento Open Source resolves critical vulnerabilities that could lead to arbitrary code execution.

items.title: Unauthenticated Arbitrary File Upload in Amasty Order Attributes
items.summary: An unauthenticated arbitrary file upload flaw in Amasty Order Attributes (versions up to 3.16.0) allows attackers to write executable files to a Magento store without logging in, potentially leading to remote code execution.

items.title: Unauthenticated PHP Object Injection in Mirasvit Cache Warmer
items.summary: Sansec discovered a critical unauthenticated PHP object injection vulnerability in Mirasvit Cache Warmer (versions before 1.11.12) that can lead to remote code execution via a crafted cookie.

items.title: Security update available for Adobe Commerce and Magento Open Source
items.summary: Adobe released a security update for Adobe Commerce and Magento Open Source, resolving critical, important, and moderate vulnerabilities that could lead to security feature bypass, application denial-of-service, privilege escalation, arbitrary code execution, and arbitrary file system read.

items.title: Unrestricted File Upload in Magento and Adobe Commerce REST API
items.summary: Sansec discovered a critical flaw, named PolyShell, in Magento's REST API that allows unauthenticated attackers to upload executable files to any store by disguising code as an image.

items.title: Incorrect Authorization Vulnerability leading to Security Feature Bypass
items.summary: An incorrect authorization vulnerability in Adobe Commerce and Magento Open Source could enable a security-feature bypass. Exploitation requires authentication and administrator privileges.

items.title: Incorrect Authorization Vulnerability leading to Privilege Escalation
items.summary: An incorrect authorization vulnerability in Adobe Commerce and Magento Open Source could result in privilege escalation. Exploitation requires authentication and administrator privileges.
